intro.text: Strong Strains is an adult-use cannabis dispensary at 19 Technology Drive in East Setauket. The team curates lab-tested, handpicked products, from flower and pre-rolls to edibles, concentrates, tinctures, topicals and accessories, and the staff knows the menu well. Shop in the store, order ahead for pickup, or get same-day delivery.
